verdict.rationale: Incident management is a reasonable axis for an observability platform, but the evidence shows no native way in Honeycomb to declare or track incidents, maintain incident timelines, run on-call schedules, or define escalation policies. Honeycomb only fires Trigger and SLO alerts and routes them through webhooks and templates to external tools such as PagerDuty, OpsGenie and incident.io, which would do the incident handling. Deploy/event markers annotate query graphs, not incident timelines.
